title: Cap. V Obj. 4: if predestination without foresight of faith, then save without satisfaction of justice
pass_a_gloss: Objection 4. If God were to predestinate certain ones to life without an intuition of antecedent faith, then he would also will to save such without satisfaction of his justice; since he would also love such more than his own proper justice: But these things are false: Therefore also that from which they follow, namely, that God predestinates anyone before foresight of faith, which applies the satisfaction of Christ to particular persons unto salvation.
pass_b_english: Obj. 4. If God predestinated some to life without intuition of antecedent faith, then he would also will to save them without satisfaction of his justice — loving them more than his own justice. But those are false. Therefore so is what follows from them: that God predestinates anyone before foresight of faith, which applies Christ's satisfaction to particular persons unto salvation.
source_text: Obj. 4. Si Deus praedestinaret quosdam ad vitam absque intuitu fidei antecedaneae, tum tales etiam servare vellet absque justitiae suae satisfactione; cum etiam tales magis diligeret, quam propriam suam justitiam: At haec falsa sunt: Ergo et illud unde consequuntur, scilicet, Deum praedestinare quenquam ante praevisionem fidei, quae satisfactionem Christi particularibus personis applicat ad salutem.
